# BlackMatrix demo

> An ATEM fleet as one router, with failover

A crosspoint router matrix over a fleet of Blackmagic ATEM switchers: sources across the top, destinations down the side, one click to route. It also serves the Videohub Ethernet Protocol, one server per switcher, so hardware router panels, Companion and a media server's own matrix driver all get at the same crosspoints. On a redundant rig it watches the main media server and fires a salvo when it stops answering.

This address is a demo of the app, running in the browser against a simulated fleet you build from the device library. Every device is made up inside the tab, so nothing is on a network and nothing is being controlled. A web page can't reach a switcher at all: the ATEM protocol is UDP and the Videohub protocol is raw TCP, and a browser can open neither. To route real hardware, run the app on the show network.
